subject: ENX / Enel X Way Italia current APK 4.3.67 and direct-payment backend validation

decision.reason: Current Android APK 4.3.67 confirms an explicit Guest charging/payment flow and retains direct-payment tariff model fields in Flutter native code. A fresh anonymous public station-detail probe returns distinct operator/app price and directPaymenthPrice values on AC, DC and HPC samples. This validates a dedicated direct-payment price surface, but national deterministic coverage against all 23,007 current PUN ENX EVSE has not yet been rebuilt, so no partial->treated promotion is made.
decision.tariffChannel: direct/ad-hoc candidate = station-detail directPaymenthPrice; app/eMSP price kept separate

findings: Pay Per Use and card pre-authorization strings present

liveBackendProbe.note: The API exposes price and directPaymenthPrice simultaneously, proving they are distinct commercial surfaces. Do not substitute price for directPaymenthPrice.

decision.resumeCondition: Run a fresh national ENX/PUN exact mapping using current public station-detail responses and directPaymenthPrice/directPaymenthTypePrice/directPaymenthPenaltyPrice. Promote only EVSE with deterministic current mapping and validated direct-payment units/penalty semantics; keep any unmatched or unsupported EVSE fail-closed.
